subject: general
question:
In the given figure, AB is parallel to CD. Angle PRB = 82 degrees. What is the value (in degrees) of angle QSC?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e652cfd345fe54584cd9d612262092af5fb5fc70d8e2ab01af8c04cee489f41e.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two lines are parallel (AB || CD), alternate exterior angles formed by a transversal are equal.

Angle PRB and Angle QSC are alternate exterior angles.

∴ Angle QSC = Angle PRB = 82°.

**∴ The correct answer is 82°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: AB || CD and transversal PQ intersects AB at R and CD at S.

Angle PRB = 82°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93541ca0bdb8685cf305cfe1d051eb3cef91d07f33a1faa3d5b6669e5dc347e3.png] 

⇒ Angle PRB and Angle RSD are corresponding angles.

⇒ Angle RSD = Angle PRB = 82°.

⇒ Angle QSC and Angle RSD are vertically opposite angles.

⇒ Angle QSC = Angle RSD = 82°.

**∴ The correct answer is 82°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Corresponding Angles

When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the angles in matching corners are equal.

Alternate Interior/Exterior Angles

Pairs of angles on opposite sides of the transversal and outside (exterior) or inside (interior) the parallel lines are equal.

Consecutive Interior Angles

Angles on the same side of the transversal and inside the parallel lines are supplementary (Sum = 180°).
